We bring them together into one clean, visual timeline—so you can protect what matters. Turn overwhelming to-do lists into clear, achievable time blocks. Whether you need structure for ADHD, deep work sessions, or just a better daily routine, LifeBlocks helps you stay mindful and balanced.

records.name: ClipScreen — Screenshot Editor
records.tagline: Make your screenshots look premium in seconds
records.description: Transform raw screenshots into clean, share-ready visuals for social media, blogs, and previews.

records.name: VEHK PMaaS
records.tagline: Predict vehicle failure before it happens
records.description: VEHK Platform as a Service for Fleet Management, Predictive Maintenance, and Real-time Analytics

records.name: EMDR.chat
records.tagline: Teletherapy tool for EMDR
records.description: EMDR.chat is a hosting platform for secure and reliable peer to peer video conferences with integrated EMDR-stimulation. Therapists can now easily schedule sessions with their clients, without the need for additional tools such as an EMDR-bar. A visual EMDR-animation is included with EMDR.chat.

records.name: Folixio
records.tagline: work, it, dev, freelance, control work, control life
records.description: All-in-one productivity workspace to manage tasks, projects, notes, contacts, and personal growth with a clean and focused interface.

records.name: SnipQA
records.tagline: Playwright & Cypress snippets — search or AI-generate
records.description: Stop Googling the same Playwright and Cypress patterns every week. SnipQA is a free searchable library of 137+ real-world automation snippets — or describe what you need and AI generates working code instantly. No account, no paywall. Built by a QA engineer for QA engineers.

records.name: StemAllDay — Subscriber Tracking
records.tagline: Track your app's signups without terminal queries or GA
records.description: StemAllDay replaces your daily MongoDB Shell routine with a single dashboard. Connect your database — MongoDB, Firebase, Supabase, or PostgreSQL — and check signup numbers every morning. No GA setup. No 12-hour App Store delays. Paste a connection string, live in 30 seconds. See all side projects on one screen Refreshes every 30 min AES-256 encrypted credentials Custom filters by plan, region, or any field Free forever for 1 project

records.name: SBTI – Brutally Honest Personality Test
records.tagline: A brutally honest 31-question test that calls you out
records.description: SBTI (Shit-Based Type Indicator) is a brutally honest personality test for today’s internet‑native generation. In 31 quick questions, it analyzes you across 15 dimensions and matches you to 1 of 27 painfully accurate personality types – from “Dior-s Loser” to “CTRL Controller” and “JOKE-R”. It uses meme culture, internet slang, and dark humor to “call you out” in a way that feels real and super shareable. After the test, you get a one‑tap shareable personality poster for TG, Instagram Etc.

records.name: Trixtu — Expat Events & Community
records.tagline: Discover events from your expat community
records.description: Find expat events, connect with yTrixtu helps expat communities discover and organize events across Europe. Whether you're Romanian in Berlin, Polish in London, or Turkish in Paris — find parties, networking, cultural events, and services from your community. 🎫 Browse & create events for free 💳 Sell tickets with Stripe (zero platform fees for organizers) 🌍 40+ cities, 7 languages (EN, DE, RO, FR, IT, PL, TR) 🔍 Filter by city, community, or category

records.name: Don't Let YouTube Track You
records.tagline: Your YouTube history, owned by you — not Google!
records.description: Stop letting Google own your YouTube history. This extension privately tracks every video, search, and channel you visit in a local SQLite database — no Google account needed. Want sync across devices? Pair with a 6-character code and your data is encrypted with AES-256 before it leaves your browser. No accounts, no sign-ups, no telemetry. Export as JSON/CSV anytime. Works on Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Brave, Arc, Opera, and Vivaldi. Open source and free.

records.name: EpicPencil
records.tagline: Screen annotation for creators & devs.
records.description: EpicPencil is a lightweight screen drawing and annotation tool designed for speed and simplicity. Unlike traditional design tools, it lets you draw directly on your screen in real time — perfect for explaining ideas, recording content, or quick visual notes. Key features: - Draw instantly on top of any app - Automatic drawing tools for fast workflows - Cross-platform: Windows, macOS, Linux Built for developers, creators, and anyone who needs to explain things visually without friction.

records.name: Supernormal
records.tagline: Your Apple Watch knows more than it's telling you.
records.description: Your Apple Watch has been collecting data you've never seen interpreted. Until now. Supernormal runs seven algorithms overnight, analyzing your HRV, resting heart rate, sleep, and wrist temperature against your personal baseline. The result: a live energy budget that updates in real time, an early warning system that watches 24/7, and Norm, an intelligence feed that only speaks when it matters. No new hardware. No subscription to start. Just the watch you already own, finally making sense.

records.name: PyChallenge
records.tagline: Learn Python by Doing
records.description: Reading tutorials teaches you syntax. PyChallenge teaches you to think in Python. Real exercises, real output, and you know instantly if you got it right.

records.name: Edgee Codex Compressor
records.tagline: Use Codex at 35.6% lower costs
records.description: We benchmarked Codex alone against Codex routed through Edgee's compression gateway on the same repo, with the same model, under the same workflow. The result: Codex + Edgee used 49.5% fewer input tokens, improved cache hit rate from 76.1% to 85.4%, and reduced total session cost by 35.6%. This post breaks down why context compression makes Codex more efficient, more frugal, and materially cheaper to run without sacrificing useful output.

records.name: Idols Of Ash
records.tagline: Idols of Ash: Grapple, Escape, & Confront Your Buried Past
records.description: Challenge ancient, corrupt idols and forge your legend in the ash-laden ruins. Master powerful magic and defy destiny in Idols of Ash. Begin your epic quest!

records.name: LLM-Citeops
records.tagline: Fix 60% scores of AEO and GEO scores without single penny.
records.description: Free CLI for Node.js. Score pages for answer-ready content (AEO) and AI trust (GEO). Print HTML, JSON, or CSV. Fail CI when scores slip.

records.name: PromptTune
records.tagline: PromptTune | AI Wedding Music Generator
records.description: Create stunning AI wedding music — BGM, vow songs, trailers, and same-day edits powered by Google Lyria 3 Pro. Perfect for wedding videographers and editors.

records.name: PFPMaker - AI Profile Picture Generator
records.tagline: Studio-quality AI photos & headshots in minutes.
records.description: PFPMaker id s powerful AI profile picture generator creates hyper-realistic professional headshots and custom avatars from simple selfies in under 10 minutes. Ditch the expensive photography studios. Featuring 50+ distinct styles, it retains your natural facial structure to deliver authentic LinkedIn headshots, corporate portraits, and aesthetic social media PFPs. It is the fastest way to upgrade your digital identity with premium, studio-grade results.

records.name: CPM Calculator for Advertisers
records.tagline: Free CPM Calculator for Advertisers & Creator
records.description: Calculate Cost Per Thousand Impressions instantly. CPMRevenue.website is a free CPM Calculator with 3 modes: - Calculate CPM from cost & impressions - Find total campaign cost from CPM rate - Estimate impressions from your budget Also includes: - YouTube CPM benchmarks by niche - CPM Formula explained - CPM vs CPC comparison - Full FAQ for advertisers & creators No signup. No ads. 100% free.

records.name: LaunchHQ
records.tagline: Waitlist pages that grow themselves
records.description: Create a free waitlist page in minutes. Collect early signups, send automated emails, and launch with momentum.

records.name: Paper Trails: A daily puzzle game
records.tagline: Find the shortest path between 2 Wikipedia pages.
records.description: I built a daily puzzle game where the goal is to get from one Wikipedia page to another in as few clicks as possible. Every day there's a new pair of pages, and everyone plays the same puzzle — so you can actually compare scores with friends and strangers. Example: LeBron James → Lakers → Pau Gasol → Spain → Peninsular War → Napoleon. Still early days — feedback very welcome!

records.name: FENET
records.tagline: Europe's First Prediction Market
records.description: FENET is Europe's decision intelligence market, a regulated exchange where you trade directly on European events and earn when the outcome proves you right. Deposit in EUR via SEPA and access markets with a compliant structure. Currently in pre-launch, FENET is building the platform and regulatory approvals while assembling market makers. Join the waitlist for priority beta access, reduced fees, and a say in which markets list first.

records.name: ARCH
records.tagline: Design production‑grade cloud architecture in your browser
records.description: ARCH is a local-first architecture designer for cloud and on-prem diagrams. Drag real provider components (AWS, Azure, GCP, IBM, Oracle, Alibaba, Huawei, on-prem), connect them with readable edges, nest regions/VPCs/subnets, and export presentation-ready PNG, SVG, or PDF and arch import/export. Visualize turns JSON, YAML, Terraform/HCL, and more into charts and explorer views. No account, no server: your work stays in the browser (IndexedDB), with offline-friendly loading after the first visit.

records.name: GhostCFO
records.tagline: Your AI CFO for smarter startup decisions.
records.description: Our idea is to build an AI CFO for startups that helps founders understand their financial health and make better decisions.The platform connects to tools like Stripe and bank accounts and turns complex financial data into simple insights.Instead of just dashboards,it explains metrics like runway, burn rate, and spending trends in plain English and suggests actions such as controlling costs, scaling marketing,or preparing for fundraising.It can also generate investor-ready updates automatically.
